It is a limit on the total amount of superannuation that can be transferred into the retirement phase.

# Non-concessional contributions cap
## Bring-forward arrangement
### Total super balance determines bring-forward cap
These limits are based on the non-concessional contributions cap being $130,000 from 1 July 2026 and the general transfer balance cap being $2.1 million.

| Total super balance on 30 June of previous year | Non-concessional contributions cap for the first year | Bring-forward period |
|-|-|-|
| $2.1 million or more | nil | Not applicable |

# Transfer balance cap
## What is the general transfer balance cap?
If you open a retirement income stream account for the first time on or after 1 July 2026, your cap is $2.1 million1.

| Date | General transfer balance cap |
|-|-|
| 1 July 2026 | $2.1 million |
